attchmntText: Bonfiglioli Transmissions Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Bonfiglioli Transmissions Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026, with a conference call scheduled for November 13, 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of 6,602 million rupees for Q3, a 30.2% year-over-year increase. EBITDA rose 38.0% to 1,289 million rupees, and net profit increased 38.2% to 871 million rupees. For the nine-month period, revenue grew 22.8% to 17,920 million rupees. The company aims for 20% revenue growth in CY26 and a 15% CAGR from CY26 to CY28. Bonfiglioli India was listed on the NSE and BSE on October 23, 2026.

attchmntText: Bonfiglioli Transmissions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Q3 & 9M CY26 Results".
voiceSummary: Bonfiglioli Transmissions Limited released unaudited financial results for the quarter and nine months ended September 30th, 2026. Revenue from operations for Q3 CY26 reached 6,602 million rupees, a 30.2% year-over-year increase. EBITDA stood at 1,289 million rupees with a 19.5% margin. Profit after tax was 871 million rupees, up 38.2% year-over-year. Earnings per share were 4.63 rupees. For the nine-month period, revenue grew 22.8% to 17,920 million rupees. Profit after tax increased 40.7% to 2,357 million rupees. Earnings per share for the nine months were 12.54 rupees. The company reported strong performance across Industry and Automation, Off-Highway Mobility, and Wind segments. Management expects revenue growth of about 20% for CY26.

attchmntText: Bonfiglioli Transmissions Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Bonfiglioli Transmissions Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026. The Board considered and approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026. This approval was based on the recommendation of the Audit Committee. The company submitted the financial results and the Limited Review Report issued by Statutory Auditors S.R. Batliboi & Associates LLP to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The meeting commenced at 4.00 p.m. and concluded at 4.27 p.m. The documents are available on the company website at www.bonfiglioli.in/Investor_Relations and on the stock exchange websites.
